stemBlocks.value: A caterer prepares sandwiches, salads and fruit cups for two events. The order matrix O = (40 25 30 / 35 20 45) has one row per event, and the unit-cost matrix c = (12 / 18 / 8) gives the cost in dollars of one sandwich, one salad and one fruit cup. (a) Calculate Oc. (b) Interpret the entries in Oc. (c) The caterer adds a delivery charge of $120 to each event. Write a column matrix showing the final cost of each event.
Think first: Multiply first to get the food cost of each event, then add the fixed delivery charge to both entries at the end.

stemBlocks.altText: Source visual for edmar-csec-p205-q19 from workbook page 205.

solutionSteps.instruction: Check the shapes match and find the order of the product.

contentBlocks.value: O is 2 × 3 and c is 3 × 1; the inner 3s agree.

solutionSteps.instruction: Multiply the first event's row into the cost column.
Multiply the second event's row into the cost column.
Add $120 to each entry for delivery.

strategyBlocks.value: Multiply each event's row into the cost column, then add a column matrix of two 120s to include delivery.

finalAnswerBlocks.value: (a) Oc = (1170 / 1140)  (b) The entries are the food costs in dollars: $1170 for the first event and $1140 for the second  (c) Adding the $120 delivery charge to each gives the final cost column matrix (1290 / 1260), that is $1290 for the first event and $1260 for the second.

whyThisWorks.value: The row-by-column rule multiplies each quantity by the cost of that same item and adds the results, which is precisely how an order is priced. Placing the unit costs in a column is what aligns each cost with its own item. A fixed charge is added afterwards because it does not depend on quantity, so it belongs in an addition, not in the multiplication.

commonErrors.misconception: Adding the $120 before multiplying, so it gets multiplied by quantities.
commonErrors.correctiveNote: Avoid this: Adding the $120 before multiplying, so it gets multiplied by quantities.

commonErrors.misconception: Pairing the salad quantity with the sandwich cost.
commonErrors.correctiveNote: Avoid this: Pairing the salad quantity with the sandwich cost.

commonErrors.misconception: Giving the final costs as a row matrix when a column matrix is asked for.
commonErrors.correctiveNote: Avoid this: Giving the final costs as a row matrix when a column matrix is asked for.

examTip.value: Fixed charges are added after the multiplication; only per-item amounts belong inside the cost column.
